# Sailfish OS

Every app in this list that runs on Sailfish OS. That is 2 apps with 1 for Plex and 1 for Jellyfin and 0 for Emby. Apps for more than one server count once per server. The legend is in [README.md](../README.md#legend) and every other platform is in [PLATFORMS.md](../PLATFORMS.md).

> **Want these apps to play straight from debrid or Usenet?** [rex](https://rex.debridmediamanager.com/) and [zurg](https://zurg.debridmediamanager.com/) are made by the team that keeps this list. [See what they do.](../README.md#from-the-maintainers)

## Video and general

- [Sailfin](https://github.com/heartfin/harbour-sailfin) - Sailfish OS client. `Jellyfin` · `Sailfish OS` · `LGPL-2.1`

## Music

- [plexfreq](https://github.com/nappa85/plexfreq) - Native Rust music player for Sailfish OS phones and the Linux desktop. `Plex` · `Linux` `Sailfish OS` · `Open source` `Free`
